solutions.title: Three solutions, one expertise
solutions.intro: The right equipment depends on your current heating, your house and how you use it. The free study decides.

airToAir.title: Air-to-air heat pump
airToAir.description: Reversible air conditioning: one outdoor unit, one or more indoor units (single-split, multi-split, ducted). Heats in winter, cools in summer, filters the air. Ideal on the Côte d'Azur, to replace electric radiators or as a complement.
airToAir.imageAlt: Wall-mounted split unit in a modern living room facing the sea

airToWater.title: Air-to-water heat pump
airToWater.description: Replaces your oil or gas boiler while keeping your radiators or underfloor heating. Also produces domestic hot water. High temperature for older houses, low temperature for recent ones.
airToWater.imageAlt: Daikin Altherma heating and hot water indoor module in a plant room

waterHeater.title: Heat pump water heater
waterHeater.description: A water heater that draws heat from the air to warm 200 to 300 litres. Three times less electricity than a standard electric water heater, and it can be set to run while your solar panels are producing.
waterHeater.imageAlt: Heat pump water heater in a laundry room

daikin.title: A brand we have installed and serviced from the start.
daikin.description: We mainly install Daikin heat pumps: reliability, available spare parts, remote control and quiet operation. Our technicians are trained on the range and handle the manufacturer warranty for you.
daikin.caption: Photo: a real Soliance installation — Altherma hydraulic module and heat pump water heater. Other brands possible depending on the study.
daikin.imageAlt: Soliance installation: Daikin Altherma hydraulic module and heat pump water heater in a garage

silence.title: Quiet
silence.description: Outdoor units among the quietest on the market, compatible with neighbourhood noise rules.

refrigerant.title: R-32 refrigerant
refrigerant.description: Lower climate impact than older refrigerants, high efficiency.

app.title: Onecta app
app.description: Scheduling, remote control and consumption tracking from your phone.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.description: Manufacturer warranty on parts, annual servicing offered through Soliance Care.

aid.title: Grants, handled by us
aid.intro: Unlike solar panels, a heat pump qualifies for renovation grants. We check your eligibility during the study and file the applications.
aid.note: Indicative amounts based on current scales, kept up to date in our grants glossary. Reduced VAT applies to homes more than 2 years old.

choice.question: Air-to-air or air-to-water: which one should I choose?
choice.answer: Air-to-water if you have water radiators or underfloor heating and want to replace a boiler. Air-to-air if you heat with electricity and also want air conditioning.

cold.question: Does a heat pump heat enough when it is cold?
cold.answer: Yes: the ranges we install work down to −15 °C or lower, more than enough in the Alpes-Maritimes and the Var, hinterland included.

solar.question: Can I pair it with my solar panels?
solar.answer: Yes, and it is the ideal pair: the heat pump and the heat pump water heater use your daytime solar production.

maintenance.question: What servicing is needed?
maintenance.answer: An annual inspection is mandatory above 4 kW. It is included the first year, then offered with Soliance Care.

timeline.question: How long until it is installed?
timeline.answer: About 10 days from first contact to signature, then 3 to 6 weeks depending on the grants to obtain before work starts. No town hall or Enedis paperwork.

steps.title: An installation in three steps
steps.intro: One day of installation in most cases, by our own refrigeration technicians and electricians. You have hot water again the same evening.

outdoorUnit.title: Outdoor unit
outdoorUnit.description: Set on pads or an anti-vibration bracket, away from bedrooms, connected to the refrigerant circuit and the electrical supply.
outdoorUnit.imageAlt: Daikin outdoor unit set on pads at the foot of a wall

indoorUnit.title: Indoor unit
indoorUnit.description: Daikin Altherma hydraulic module and tank in the plant room, connected to your existing heating circuit.
indoorUnit.imageAlt: Daikin Altherma hydraulic module installed in a plant room

commissioning.title: Commissioning
commissioning.description: Settings, heating curve, control app: our technician tunes the unit and shows you how it works before leaving.
commissioning.imageAlt: Soliance technician configuring the heat pump from a laptop

explainer.title: From the air outside.
explainer.scrollHint: Keep scrolling to follow the energy

capture.label: Capture
capture.title: The air already holds heat.
capture.description: The fan circulates outdoor air. The evaporator captures its heat and transfers it to the refrigerant, even when the air feels cool.

compress.label: Transform
compress.title: The temperature rises.
compress.description: The electrically powered compressor compresses the refrigerant. Its temperature rises, making the captured energy useful for heating.

comfort.label: Release
comfort.title: Your home receives the heat.
comfort.description: The heat exchanger transfers heat to the water in your radiators or underfloor heating. The refrigerant expands, then the cycle starts again.
